records.subject: You're in -- let's get Union Media set up
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Union Media* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets, and no customer reply to either outreach [email:965d1a29, email:c062851d]. The held onboarding call [calendar:1e9963f3] is a positive intent signal, but two days later there's still no product activity, so unaided activation in 8 days is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: Following up on our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call on Monday — good to talk through what Union Media wants out of Wrenfield.

The usual first step from here is creating one project and adding a few tasks to it, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. When you're ready to bring the rest of the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you live.

Best,
Nadia
